verdict_rationale: Sentinel discipline is strong (128 files / 323 PHPUnit methods + 33 Vitest specs). All 6 CLAUDE.md §7 frozen files are sentinel-protected. Q9-S1, Q10, Q12, D1, D2, D10 fixes are each locked by a dedicated sentinel that exercises the exact failure mode (not just structural existence). Coverage of critical paths (PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment, PricingService::calculateOrder, OrderStateMachine, FiscalSequenceService concurrent) is covered. Identified gaps are P2/P3 hardening opportunities (naming convention, baseline ratchet, helper consistency, placeholder assertions, kiosk wizard emits sentinel) — none block V1 ship. Verdict is GREEN with the explicit caveat that execution status is read-only-inferred from external convergence reports; a fresh CI run would convert this from GREEN-attested to GREEN-verified.
